title: Heat Wave Resilient Systems Architecture for Underwater Data Centers (Periola, Alonge & Ogudo, Scientific Reports 12, 2022)
notes: Peer-reviewed open-access (Nature Sci Rep, 2022-10-13). Marine heat waves limit cold water available for UDC cooling; warm exit temperatures 'pose a threat to marine life'; proposes reservoir-as-a-service to extend operational duration ~5-12%. Modeling/simulation study, not a field measurement of ecological impact. Backs the concern side of the underwater-DC section; no-large-impact side is [134]/[135]. No ecosystem-distortion or fisher-displacement finding.
